name: Feature Quality Loop
description: Implement a scoped feature through source analysis, test strategy, implementation, validation, review, and handoff.
approval_boundaries: Do not broaden product behavior without user direction.
Do not perform external mutations without separate authorization.

phases.name: Source context
phases.instructions: Inspect authoritative source and state acceptance criteria before planning.

phases.name: Implementation plan
phases.instructions: Create small, ordered implementation slices with explicit validation targets.

phases.name: Test strategy
phases.instructions: Independently propose the smallest useful behavioral test strategy.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.instructions: Implement the approved slices and tests while preserving unrelated work.

phases.name: Independent validation
phases.instructions: Run or inspect focused validation and capture commands, exit codes, and results.

phases.name: Independent review
phases.instructions: Review the concrete diff and identify evidence-based findings.

phases.name: Review-ready handoff
phases.instructions: Summarize scope, validation, findings, risks, and the exact next action.
